# fortinet — 2020 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 46 fortinet CVEs of 2020 are in `data/cve/vendors/fortinet/2020.jsonl`.

### CVE-2020-9287
- Assigner: fortinet | Published: 2020-03-15 | Updated: 2026-10-13 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-426 Execute unauthorized code or commands
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:H/E:F/RL:O/RC:C`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A untrusted search path vulnerability in Fortinet  may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via network exploitable

**solutions:** CVE-2019-5589: Use FortiClient for Windows online installer 6.0.6 or above
CVE-2020-9290: Use FortiClient for Windows online installer 6.4.7 or above, 7.0.1 or above, and FortiClient VPN for Windows online installer 6.4.7 or above, 7.0.1 or above
CVE-2020-9287: Use FortiClient EMS online installer 6.2.9 or above, 6.4.7 or above, 7.0.1 or above.

### CVE-2020-12812
- Assigner: fortinet | Published: 2020-07-24 | Updated: 2026-10-01 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: Improper Access Control; CWE-287 CWE-287 Improper Authentication
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Known — Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Improper Authentication Vulnerability

An improper authentication vulnerability in SSL VPN in FortiOS 6.4.0, 6.2.0 to 6.2.3, 6.0.9 and below may result in a user being able to log in successfully without being prompted for the second factor of authentication (FortiToken) if they changed the case of their username.

Affected:
- n/a / Fortinet FortiOS: affected FortiOS 6.4.0, 6.2.0 to 6.2.3, 6.0.9 and below

### CVE-2020-15934
- Assigner: fortinet | Published: 2024-12-19 | Updated: 2024-12-20 | Max CVSS: 8.6
- CWE: CWE-269 Escalation of privilege
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H/E:F/RL:X/RC:X`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An execution with unnecessary privileges vulnerability in the VCM engine of FortiClient for Linux versions 6.2.7 and below, version 6.4.0. may allow local users to elevate their privileges to root by creating a malicious script or program on the target machine.

**solutions:** Please upgrade to FortiClient for Linux versions 6.2.8 or above. 
Please upgrade to FortiClient for Linux versions 6.4.1 or above.

Affected:
- Fortinet / FortiClientLinux: affected 6.4.0; affected 6.2.6 <=6.2.7 (semver); affected 6.2.0 <=6.2.4 (semver); affected 6.0.8; affected 6.0.0 <=6.0.6 (semver)

References:
- https://www.fortiguard.com/psirt/FG-IR-20-110
